title_km: លីមីតរ៉ាឌីកាល់ (ការគុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់រាង 0/0)

exercises.technique_km: គុណភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x + 5} + 3) បាន (x + 5 - 9) = (x - 4) រួចសម្រួល (x - 4)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate (sqrt(x + 5) + 3), expand to (x - 4) and cancel

exercises.technique_km: គុណនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (x + \sqrt{2x + 3}) ភាគយកបាន x^2 - 2x - 3 = (x - 3)(x + 1) រួចសម្រួល (x - 3)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate (x + sqrt(2x + 3)), expand to (x - 3)(x + 1) and cancel (x - 3)

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x + 1} + 2) ភាគយកបាន x - 3 = -(3 - x) រួចសម្រួល (3 - x)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate (sqrt(x + 1) + 2), simplify (x - 3)/(-(x - 3)) = -1

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x^2 - 2} + \sqrt{2}) ភាគបែងបាន x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply denominator by conjugate, expand to (x - 2)(x + 2) and cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: គុណភាគបែងនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x + 7} + 3) បាន x - 2 = -(2 - x) រួចសម្រួល
exercises.technique_en: Multiply denominator by conjugate (sqrt(x + 7) + 3), cancel (2 - x)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកផលដកគូប (x - 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4) និងគុណភាគបែងនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x + 2} + 2) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor difference of cubes in numerator and rationalize denominator with conjugate, cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{2 + x} + 3) ភាគយកបាន x - 7 រួចសម្រួល (x - 7)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate (sqrt(2 + x) + 3), simplify numerator to (x - 7) and cancel

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{1 + x} + \sqrt{1 - x}) ភាគយកបាន (1 + x) - (1 - x) = 2x រួចសម្រួល x
exercises.technique_en: Multiply numerator by conjugate (sqrt(1 + x) + sqrt(1 - x)), simplify to 2x/(4x) = 1/2

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{a - x}) ភាគយកបាន a - (a - x) = x រួចសម្រួល x
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate (sqrt(a) + sqrt(a - x)), cancel x to evaluate 1/(2a*sqrt(a))

exercises.technique_km: សម្រួលកត្តារួម (x + \sqrt{x}) និង (\sqrt{x} + 1) រួចទាញ \sqrt{x}(\sqrt{x} - 1)/(\sqrt{x} - 1) = \sqrt{x} = 1
exercises.technique_en: Cancel common factors, simplifying to sqrt(x) = 1

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{x^3 + 1} + 3) ភាគយកបាន x^3 - 8 = (x - 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by conjugate, expand numerator to x^3 - 8 = (x - 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4) and cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ពីរជាន់ ទាំងភាគយក (\sqrt{x + 2} + 2) និងភាគបែង (\sqrt{x + 7} + 3) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by both numerator and denominator conjugates, cancel shared (x - 2) factor

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ពីរជាន់ ភាគយកបាន x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2) និងភាគបែងបាន (x - 2) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by both conjugates, factor x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2) and cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ពីរជាន់ ភាគយកបាន (x + 4) - (3x + 4) = -2x និងភាគបែងបាន x រួចសម្រួល x
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by both conjugates, numerator simplifies to -2x and denominator to x, cancel x

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ឬសគូប (A^2 + AB + B^2) ភាគយកបាន x^2 + 1 - 1 = x^2 រួចសម្រួល x^2
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by cube root conjugate (A^2 + AB + B^2), simplify numerator to x^2 and cancel x^2

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ឬសគូប (\sqrt[3]{x^2} + \sqrt[3]{x} + 1) ភាគយកបាន x - 1 រួចសម្រួល (x - 1)
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by cube root conjugate (x^(2/3) + x^(1/3) + 1), simplify numerator to (x - 1) and cancel
Rewrite as difference of cubes in terms of u = sqrt(x), evaluating to 3a

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ឬសគូប ភាគយកបាន (x + 1) - (1 - x) = 2x រួចសម្រួល x
exercises.technique_en: Multiply by cube root conjugate, numerator simplifies to 2x, cancel x

exercises.technique_km: វិធីថែមថយ 2៖ បំបែកជា [(\sqrt[3]{x + 8} - 2) - (\sqrt{x + 4} - 2)]/(2x) រួចគណនាលីមីតនីមួយៗ
exercises.technique_en: Split by adding/subtracting 2 into two sub-limits: [(cbrt(x+8)-2) - (sqrt(x+4)-2)]/(2x)

exercises.technique_km: វិធីថែមថយ 1៖ បំបែកជា [(\sqrt{1 + x} - 1) - (\sqrt[3]{1 + 2x} - 1)]/x រួចគណនាលីមីត
exercises.technique_en: Split by adding/subtracting 1 into two sub-limits: [(sqrt(1+x)-1) - (cbrt(1+2x)-1)]/x
Split by grouping (sqrt(x+4) - 3) and -(sqrt(x-4) - 1) over (x - 5)
Split by adding/subtracting 2: [(4th_root(x+10) - 2) - (sqrt(x-2) - 2)]/(x - 6)
Apply derivative definition for n-th roots: (1/2017)/(1/2016) = 2016/2017

exercises.technique_km: រូបមន្តទូទៅ៖ \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x^{1/n} - 1}{x^{1/m} - 1} = \frac{1/n}{1/m} = \frac{m}{n}
exercises.technique_en: General formula: lim (x^(1/n) - 1)/(x^(1/m) - 1) = m/n
